title: Bioimpedance body composition analysis
what: A very weak current that you will not feel is passed through your body. The device works out how much fat, muscle, and water your body has.
why: To plan nutrition and weight loss, to track weight, and for some health conditions, when a doctor orders it.
duration: usually 5 to 10 minutes; the result is given right away
tell_doctor: If you have a pacemaker or another implanted device. The test is usually not done

prepare.title: Food and water
prepare.text: Usually do not eat or drink a lot for 2 to 4 hours before the test. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Toilet
prepare.text: Use the toilet before the measurement.

prepare.title: Jewelry
prepare.text: Take off metal jewelry and your watch.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: You are weighed and your height is measured
You lie on an exam table or stand on an analyzer scale
Electrodes are stuck on your hand and foot, or you hold handles
You lie or stand still for a few minutes
feel: You feel nothing. The current is very weak
The electrodes may feel cool on your skin
after: You get a printout right away
For repeat measurements, it is better to come at the same time of day and in the same conditions
Go over the result with your doctor

faq.a: It is a good estimate, but food, water, and the time of day affect the result. Compare measurements taken in the same conditions.

faq.q: Can I do it with a pacemaker?
faq.a: Usually not. Be sure to say so ahead of time.

reminders.text: Body composition test soon. Do not eat or drink a lot for 2 to 4 hours before. Take off your jewelry.
